description: List the plugins the user connected in BAMF for a workspace (GitHub, Gmail, Google Calendar, and remote MCP providers such as Fireflies), each with its status (connected, needs_reauth, not_connected) and the exact tools you can call through bamf.plugins.call: name, short description, access (read or write) and argument hints. Remote MCP tools are listed live. Never returns tokens or secrets. Requires plugins:read. workspace_id is optional: defaults to the key's pinned workspace, else your first workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID (optional; defaults to the key's pinned workspace).

name: bamf.plugins.list
